summary: AstraZeneca filed a Form 6-K to report that the FDA's ODAC recommended Truqap (capivasertib) in combination with abiraterone and ADT for PTEN-deficient metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, based on CAPItello-281 Phase III trial results. The Committee voted 7-1-1 favoring the benefit-risk profile. No financial terms, transaction structure, or deal mechanics are involved; this is a regulatory update on a drug development program. The filing does not trigger any special-situation category. Routine disclosure of FDA advisory committee recommendation with no acquisition, divestiture, or capital event.
